name: Canbus → On Frame
description: An automation to perform when a CAN frame is received. See [`on_frame` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/canbus/#canbus-on-frame).

config_entries.label: Can ID
config_entries.description: The CAN ID which, when received, will trigger this automation.

config_entries.label: Can ID Mask
config_entries.description: The bit mask to apply to the received CAN ID before trying to match it with *can_id*. Defaults to `0x1fffffff` (all bits of received CAN ID are compared with *can_id*).

config_entries.label: Remote Transmission Request
config_entries.description: Whether to run for CAN frames with the "remote transmission request" bit set or not set. Defaults to not checking (the automation will run for both cases).

config_entries.label: Use Extended ID
config_entries.description: Identifies the type of `can_id` to match on. Defaults to `false`.
